verdicts.reason: mhp_range_allowed checks address ranges, mem_hotplug_begin locks hotplug, sparse_add_section populates sections, and __alloc_pages_slowpath handles reclaim/compaction, but online types are not covered.
The cited functions compute movable zone PFN starts, initialize zone memmap ranges and holes, size system hashes to powers of two via log2qty, and initialize/tune per-CPU page caches and batch sizes.
set_migratetype_isolate guards unmovable checks and isolation with zone->lock irqsave, zone_pcp_disable holds pcp_batch_high_lock to suspend/drain PCPs, and hotplug/kswapd locks serialize removal.
memblock_region, memblock_type, and NR_PAGE_ORDERS support the memblock fields, counted region types, and buddy order bounds, but no cited symbol or fragment covers NUMA node spans.

overall: Findings 2 and 3 are fully supported by their cited fragments; Finding 1 lacks support for online types, and Finding 4 lacks any citation or fragment for NUMA spans.
